# PRINEOR (https://prineor.com)

> PRINEOR is a premier digital brand founded in 2026, delivering high-impact digital experiences across web development, WordPress engineering, artificial intelligence solutions, UI/UX design, and digital marketing worldwide.

## Brand Identity
- Official Domain: https://prineor.com
- Founder & Creative Technologist: Dawood Muzahir
- Official Contact Email: prineorofficial@gmail.com
- Headquarters & Origin: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Service Scope: Global / Worldwide (Pakistan, US, UK, UAE, Europe)

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Custom Web Development: React 19, Vite, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript full-stack applications.
- WordPress Engineering: Custom themes, Elementor & Gutenberg architectures, WooCommerce e-commerce, custom plugin integrations, core web vitals optimization.
- AI Solutions & Automation: Google Gemini SDK integration, custom AI chatbots, intelligent consultation assistants, automated workflows.
- Brand Strategy & UI/UX Design: Luxury visual identities, design systems, conversion-driven landing pages, interactive 3D crystal aesthetics.
- Digital Marketing & Social Media: Multi-platform branding across TikTok (@prineorofficial), Instagram (@prineorofficial), YouTube (@Prineorofficial), Facebook.
